## About
Allstate Auto Repair is a full service automotive repair and maintenance shop serving the La Crescenta area. We keep things friendly, clean and efficient, because we know car trouble can be stressful.
Juan, the owner, supervises the work in the shop, and many of our customers have been bringing their cars to us for years. Reviewers often say the same things about us: honest, efficient and professional.
We hold a 4.7 rating on Google from 46 reviews, and we're grateful to every neighbor who has trusted us with their car.

## Services
- Oil changes: Oil changes to keep your car maintained and running well.
- Brakes and shocks: Brake and shock work for your car.
- Tires and batteries: Tire and battery replacement.
- Engine repair: Engine work along with general repairs for your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: What kind of work do you do?
A: We're a full service shop, so we handle both maintenance and repairs for your car.

Q: My car has been sitting for a long time. Can you check it over?
A: Yes. We can look the car over for any maintenance it needs and make sure it's safe to drive again.

Q: Who will be working on my car?
A: Juan, the owner, and his team. Juan supervises the work done in the shop.
